method.dataset: Non-media tool outputs from the most recently modified local Codex sessions.
method.arm_b: Working-tree Capsule with silent control tags, near-duplicate delta replay, and adaptive reasoning thresholds.
method.exact_replay: Each real output is replayed byte-identically; accounting includes replacement plus hook-added context.
method.delta_replay: Actual changed outputs are paired only when the tool name and serialized input are identical.
method.privacy: The report stores only session basenames, tool names, sizes, booleans, and aggregates; content is not copied.
method.caveat: Characters are a model-visible text proxy, not billing. Reasoning thresholds are policy activation points, not a claimed model-token reduction.
